summary: A small computer model, not tests on people, gave Sulfaphenazole a high score of 92 for liver concerns and a low score of 25 for heart concerns [M]. Several similar drugs have been removed from the market, including Sulfathiazole, which was pulled in the United States and two other countries due to kidney harm, liver harm, and serious skin reactions [3]. Another related drug, Sulfamethazine, was pulled from the market in Germany in 1992 [4]. Additionally, Sulfacarbamide was taken off the market in Germany in 1988 because of liver harm and blood problems [5].
